The court will most likely uphold the statute as constitutional. Ballot-access rules are judged under the Anderson-Burdick balancing test, not strict scrutiny, so the team note's free-speech framing doesn't change the outcome. The 180-day circulation period matches the party deadline, and the 20% line is objective, as in *Jenness v. Fortson* (5% upheld) and *Storer v. Brown*. The 7% figure is the most vulnerable element, which is why my confidence is moderate.

CONFIDENCE: 62
